note: I1 declaration: the single list of canonical system components. OS-resident model (owner decision 2026-08-08): system member bodies are NEVER copied into packages. The measured copy contract was dead (0 of 32 live teams carried the canonical body), and the runtimes already seed the roles as builtins / enforce them at chokepoints. Packages carry only the outputs (.agentlas/memory-map.json, memory-tickets.jsonl, soul log). Canonical bodies remain the authoring source for the builtin prompts and deep-role invocations; canonical changes propagate by ENGINE RELEASE, not package rebuild. Per-agent domain assets (skills/knowledge/styles/data/scripts/benchmarks) are exempt (I5).

components.notes: Never copied into packages. Recall reaches an agent through the host capsule, but emission is the agent's job, and an agent borrowed onto a host without the Agentlas hook was never told to emit - it left a request hash and lost the learning. Injecting from the emitter reaches every borrowed agent from one place instead of asking 178 packages to each carry the same text.

components.notes: The fourth runtime built-in, alongside the meta-agent, PM Soul, and the Memory Curator. Not copied into packages: it governs a project folder, not an agent. It is the write owner of the sitemap memory root - the memory map must name it, not project bootstrap.
